\expandafter\gdef\csname map@table@t-lf-counters\endcsname{\begin{tabular}{lp{0.45\linewidth}}
$\displaystyle o : S_x^{\lfadd{a,m}} \Rightarrow a \leq f(o) \leq m$ & an end type $S_x^{\lfadd{a,m}}$ has its point in the subscript, its credit $a$ and its tickets $m$ in the superscript, and its counter $f$ lies between the two \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle S_x^{\lfadd{a}},\ (T \mathrel{\multimap} U)^{\lfadd{a}}$ & a lower bound on the counter of an end, or of the ends a closure captured \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle e : T\ !\ c$ & the term performs at most $c$ actions before it returns \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \Delta - c$ & what is held while $e$ runs loses $c$, and each credit must be at least $c$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \mathsf{Skip}_x^{\lfadd{a}} - c$ & an idle end loses credit without the check \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle S_x^{\lfadd{a,m}},\ a \leq m$ & an upper bound on the counter, the value an action resets it to \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle S_{x^{+}}^{\lfadd{m,m}}$ & an action returns its end with credit $m$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \mathsf{tk}(o) + \mathsf{tk}(\overline{o}) \leq N$ & the two ends of a channel have at most $N$ tickets together \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle T' - 1 \leq T[x\cdot i]$ & a sent end loses one \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle (T \mathrel{\multimap} U)^{\lfadd{a}} : \Delta - a$ & the body of a closure is typed with each captured end at its credit minus $a$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle a_1 + m_2 > N,\ a_2 + m_1 > N$ & after a link the new dual end of a waiting end has a lower counter than the old one \\[0.5ex]
\end{tabular}}%
\expandafter\gdef\csname map@table@t-lf-wf\endcsname{\begin{tabular}{lp{0.45\linewidth}}
$\displaystyle \varrho : \mathsf{Point} \to \mathsf{Ord}$ & a ranked world orders its points by ordinals \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \mathsf{gen\_new}\,\Gamma\,\rho\,C$ & E-New at a fresh base asks that the new tree can be ranked \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \mathsf{ranked}\,W$ & process typing at a finite bound asks a ranked world \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \varrho(x)$ & lock-free adequacy ranks a thread waiting on an end at $x$ by $\varrho(x)$ \\[0.5ex]
\end{tabular}}%

\expandafter\gdef\csname map@table@sr-reading\endcsname{\begin{tabular}{lp{0.45\linewidth}}
$\displaystyle v \in V^{W}_{\alpha}\llbracket \Theta \vdash T \rrbracket$ & the value $v$ owns exactly the ends $\Theta$ and is safe at $T$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle e \in E^{W}_{\alpha}\llbracket \Theta \vdash T \rrbracket^{F}$ & the term $e$, holding $\Theta$, is safe until it returns a value of $T$, its context acting at $F$ afterwards \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle p \in P^{W}_{\alpha}\llbracket \Sigma \vdash T \rrbracket$ & the process $p$ is safe with interface $\Sigma$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \mathsf{Obl}_\ell(e')$ & what a step $e \xrightarrow{\ell} e'$ must preserve \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle e'\ \mathsf{at}\ \Theta'$ & $e'$ is safe holding $\Theta'$, at the same index after a free step and at each $\beta$ with $\beta + c \leq \alpha$ after a step of cost $c$ \\[0.5ex]
\lfadd{$\displaystyle e \in F^{N}_{\alpha}\llbracket \Phi \vdash \sigma\ !\ d \rrbracket$} & the thread $e$, holding $\Phi$ with counters and tickets, has fuel at index $\alpha$ \\[0.5ex]
\lfadd{$\displaystyle a \in S^{N,W}_{\alpha}\llbracket \Sigma \vdash T \rrbracket$} & each thread of $a$ is in $E[\kappa_L]$ and has fuel, under one ownership map \\[0.5ex]
\end{tabular}}%
\expandafter\gdef\csname map@block@sr-ord\endcsname{\begin{array}{l}
\alpha, \beta ::= 0 \mid \alpha + 1 \mid \sup_{x \in X} f(x) \qquad {\beta < \alpha \iff \beta + 1 \leq \alpha} \qquad {\nexists (\alpha_i)_{i \in \mathbb{N}}.\ \forall i.\ \alpha_{i+1} < \alpha_i} \\
\beta + c = \beta \underbrace{+ 1 \cdots + 1}_{c}  \\ \lfadd{(\forall \alpha.\ \exists x.\ P\,x\,\alpha) \land (\beta \leq \alpha \land P\,x\,\alpha \Rightarrow P\,x\,\beta) \Rightarrow \exists x.\ \forall \alpha.\ P\,x\,\alpha}
\end{array}}%

\alpha, \beta ::= 0 \mid \alpha + 1 \mid \sup_{x \in X} f(x) \qquad {\beta < \alpha \iff \beta + 1 \leq \alpha} \qquad {\nexists (\alpha_i)_{i \in \mathbb{N}}.\ \forall i.\ \alpha_{i+1} < \alpha_i} \\
\beta + c = \beta \underbrace{+ 1 \cdots + 1}_{c} 
\end{array}}%
\expandafter\gdef\csname map@blocklf@sr-ord\endcsname{\begin{array}{l}
\alpha, \beta ::= 0 \mid \alpha + 1 \mid \sup_{x \in X} f(x) \qquad {\beta < \alpha \iff \beta + 1 \leq \alpha} \qquad {\nexists (\alpha_i)_{i \in \mathbb{N}}.\ \forall i.\ \alpha_{i+1} < \alpha_i} \\

\end{array}}%
\expandafter\gdef\csname map@block@ct-costs\endcsname{\begin{array}{c}\begin{array}{lcc}
 & \kappa_{DF} & \lfadd{\kappa_L} \\ \hline
{\beta} & 1 & 0 \\
\mathsf{force} & 1 & 1 \\
\mathsf{new} & 1 & 0 \\
\mathsf{spawn} & 1 & 0 \\
\mathsf{link} & 0 & 0 \\
\mathsf{send},\ \mathsf{select},\ \mathsf{close} & 0 & 1 \\
\mathsf{recv},\ \mathsf{branch} & 1 & 1 \\
\kappa_{\mathrm{give}} + \kappa_{\mathrm{take}} & 1 & 2

\kappa = (\kappa_\beta, \kappa_{\mathrm{force}}, \kappa_{\mathrm{new}}, \kappa_{\mathrm{spawn}}, \kappa_{\mathrm{link}}, \kappa_{\mathrm{give}}, \kappa_{\mathrm{take}}) \in \mathbb{N}^{7} \\
1 \leq \kappa_{\mathrm{force}} \qquad {1 \leq \kappa_{\mathrm{take}}} \qquad {\kappa_\beta = 0 \Rightarrow 1 \leq \kappa_{\mathrm{give}}} \qquad {\kappa_{\mathrm{give}} \leq \kappa_{\mathrm{take}}}
\end{array}}\end{array}}%

 & \kappa_{DF} \\ \hline

\expandafter\gdef\csname map@table@fu-vs\endcsname{\begin{tabular}{lll}
\textit{} & \textit{the relation} & \textit{fuel} \\ \hline
a thread & $e \in {E^{W}_{\alpha}\llbracket \Theta \vdash T \rrbracket^{F}}$ & $e \in {F^{N}_{\alpha}\llbracket {\Phi} \vdash \sigma\ !\ d \rrbracket}$ \\
an end & $o \mapsto S_x$ in $\Theta$ & $o \mapsto S^{f,m}$ in $\Phi$ \\
a value & $v \in {V^{W}_{\alpha}\llbracket \Theta \vdash T \rrbracket}$ & $v \in {FV^{N}_{\alpha}\llbracket {\Phi} \vdash T^{a} \rrbracket}$ \\
a step $e \xrightarrow{\ell} e'$ & $\mathsf{Obl}_\ell(e')$, the successor at each $\beta$ with $\beta + c \leq \alpha$, or at $\alpha$ after a free step & $\mathsf{Fobl}_\ell(e')$, the successor at each $\beta < \alpha$ \\

worlds & each extension $W' \sqsupseteq W$ & none \\

\expandafter\gdef\csname map@block@fu-obls\endcsname{\begin{array}{c}

\expandafter\gdef\csname map@table@soup\endcsname{\begin{tabular}{llll}
$\displaystyle a = (q, K, W_a) \qquad {K(o) = (t, x, f, m)}$ &  &  &  \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle a \in {S^{N,W}_\alpha\llbracket\Sigma \vdash T\rrbracket}$ & $\displaystyle \iff$ & $\displaystyle W \sqsubseteq W_a \land {\mathsf{tfree}\,T} \land {\exists {\Delta : K},\ U}.\ \mathsf{wa}^{N}_{\Sigma}(a, \Delta) \land \forall t.\ q(t) = e \Rightarrow$ &  \\[0.5ex]
 &  & $\displaystyle \quad {e \in {E[\kappa_L]^{W_a}_\alpha\llbracket \Delta^{E}_t \vdash U_t\rrbracket^{\varnothing}}}$ & the relation at the ends $t$ owns \\[0.5ex]
 &  & $\displaystyle \quad {}\land {e \in {F^{N}_{\alpha}\llbracket \Delta^{F}_t \vdash {\mathsf{thread}}\ !\ \infty \rrbracket}}$ & fuel at their counters \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \Delta : K$ & $\displaystyle \iff$ & $\displaystyle \mathrm{dom}\,\Delta = \mathrm{dom}\,K \land (K(o) = (t, x, f, m) \Rightarrow \Delta(o) = (S_x, P^{f,m}))$ & $\displaystyle U_t \in \{T, \ast\}$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \Delta^{E}_t,\ \Delta^{F}_t$ &  & the maps $o \mapsto S_x$ and $o \mapsto P^{f,m}$ on the ends that $K$ gives $t$ &  \\[0.5ex]
\end{tabular}}%
\expandafter\gdef\csname map@block@sj-all\endcsname{\begin{array}{c}\begin{array}{l}
\Delta \mathrel{\vDash[\kappa]}^{X}_W e : T \iff \forall \alpha, W' \mathrel{\sqsupseteq} W, \Theta', \gamma.\ |\Delta| \mathbin{\#} \Theta' \land {} \\
\quad {\gamma \in G[\kappa]^{W'}_{\alpha}\llbracket\Theta' \vdash \Delta\rrbracket \Rightarrow \gamma(e) \in {E[\kappa]^{W'}_{\alpha}\llbracket |\Delta| \cup \Theta' \vdash T\rrbracket^{X}}} \\
\Delta \vDash[\kappa]^{F}_W e : T \iff \forall Y.\ \Delta \vDash[\kappa]^{\mathsf{den}_{Y}(F)}_W e : T \\
\Sigma \vDash[\kappa]_W p : T \iff \forall W' \mathrel{\sqsupseteq} W.\ \mathsf{cons}\,W' \lfadd{\land {\mathsf{strict}}\,W'} \Rightarrow {\forall \alpha.\ p \in {P[\kappa]^{W'}_{\alpha}\llbracket\Sigma \vdash T\rrbracket}}
\end{array}\\[3ex]\lfadd{\begin{array}{l}
\Sigma \Vvdash^{\lfadd{N}}_W p : T \iff {\forall W' \mathrel{\sqsupseteq} W.\ \mathsf{ranked}\,W' \Rightarrow \forall \alpha.\ \exists a.\ \mathsf{erase}(q_a) = p} \land a \in {S^{N,W'}_\alpha\llbracket\Sigma \vdash T\rrbracket}
\end{array}}\end{array}}%
\expandafter\gdef\csname map@blockdf@sj-all\endcsname{\begin{array}{c}\begin{array}{l}
\Delta \mathrel{\vDash}^{X}_W e : T \iff \forall \alpha, W' \mathrel{\sqsupseteq} W, \Theta', \gamma.\ |\Delta| \mathbin{\#} \Theta' \land {} \\
\quad {\gamma \in G^{W'}_{\alpha}\llbracket\Theta' \vdash \Delta\rrbracket \Rightarrow \gamma(e) \in {E^{W'}_{\alpha}\llbracket |\Delta| \cup \Theta' \vdash T\rrbracket^{X}}} \\
\Delta \vDash^{F}_W e : T \iff \forall Y.\ \Delta \vDash^{\mathsf{den}_{Y}(F)}_W e : T \\
\Sigma \vDash_W p : T \iff \forall W' \mathrel{\sqsupseteq} W.\ \mathsf{cons}\,W' \Rightarrow {\forall \alpha.\ p \in {P^{W'}_{\alpha}\llbracket\Sigma \vdash T\rrbracket}}
\end{array}\end{array}}%

\expandafter\gdef\csname map@table@alg-oracles\endcsname{\begin{tabular}{ll}
\textit{oracle} & \textit{decides} \\ \hline
entailment & $\Gamma \vdash_W x \prec y$ \\
instance of a constraint & $\Gamma \mathrel{\vdash_W} C[\bar x]$ \\
conservativity & $\mathsf{conserv}_{\Gamma}(\bar\iota, C)$ \\
creation & $\lfalt{\mathsf{acyc\_new}}{\mathsf{new\_ok}_N}\,\Gamma\,\rho\,C$ \\
equality of constraints & $C = C'$ \\
session types & $S \approx S'\lfadd{ \qquad S \mathrel{\sqsubseteq} S'}$ \\
\end{tabular}}%
